name: fable-advisor
description: Run your session on Fable 5.1 as a full-time architect: it writes specs and verdicts and picks a reasoning effort per task, Grok 4.6 (via the Cursor CLI) and GPT-5.6 Luna (via Codex) share the routine typing, GPT-5.6 Sol takes the high-complexity one-offs — and both Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra review every deliverable before it ships.
